clips.text: On the road to God the only sustenance is infinite hope - hope shining like the north star in darkness, hope keeping you company like a shadow in loneliness.
Dark and lonely life's path certainly is - but only for those without hope.
The famous geographical explorer Donald Macmillan was preparing for his journey to the north pole when he received a letter.
On it was written: To be opened only when there is no hope of survival.
Fifty years passed; the envelope remained with Macmillan as it was - sealed.
Someone asked him the reason for this and he replied: For one thing I want to keep faith with the unknown sender, and for another, I have never given up hope.
What priceless words! - I have never given up hope!
